theater: 湖南潭州長沙城與湘江水道

battle.name: 潭州之戰
battle.theater: 湖南潭州長沙城與湘江水道
battle.brief: 至元十二年（1275）冬，元軍分兵自江西、湖廣入湖南，伯顏主力沿長江東下，阿術等軍圍潭州（長沙），築營列砲，數攻不克；至元十三年（1276）正月城破，元軍順湘江直抵臨安。卡面希臘火為這條戰線縱火技術之源頭：拜占庭銅管噴射燃燒劑的後裔，與宋軍猛火油、火矢及元軍投擲火球同屬一脈。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 潭州之戰是南宋與元朝在湖南戰線上的一次決定性圍城戰。開戰方是元朝：至元十二年（1275）冬，世祖忽必烈命樞密院主持東路、南路兩路大軍，伯顏統主力沿漢水、長江順流東下，阿術等率騎兵與漢軍由江西道入湖南，董文炳、范文虎各領舟師在長江與鄱陽湖一線協同，呂文煥等襄樊降軍編入前鋒，劉整所獻之策定下先取鄂州、再順流直下的全盤作戰方針。宋方是臨安朝廷，丞相賈似道以總領諸路兵馬之權節制兩淮、荊湖、兩浙兵馬，潭州一線由湖南制置司與知潭州事主持城防，張世傑等率江面舟師往來策應，文天祥於江西起兵勤王。雙方體制懸殊：元軍以漠北騎兵為骨幹，漢地步卒、匠役與水軍輔之，攻城序列配回回炮與穴地工匠；宋軍則以步卒結陣、倚城而守，城上用弓弩、火矢與火藥器械。兵種、補給與火力三者都不在同一個世代。
countriesEn: The Battle of Tanchow was a decisive siege fought on the Hunan front between the Southern Song and the Yuan dynasty. The attackers were the Yuan: in the winter of 1275, Kublai Khan ordered the Privy Council to mount two great armies, one on the eastern and one on the southern route. Bayan led the main body down the Han and the Yangtze with the current; Asu took cavalry and Chinese-raised foot and horse troops into Hunan along the Jiangxi road; Dong Wenbing and Fan Wenhu each commanded flotillas on the Yangtze and around Poyang; the surrendered garrison of Xiangyang under Lü Wenhuan was folded into the vanguard; and the strategy offered by the defector Liu Zheng, to strike Ezhou first and then ride the river down to Lin'an, set the frame for the entire campaign. On the Song side stood the court at Lin'an, where the chancellor Jia Sidao, holding overall command of the armies of the Two Huai, the Jinghu and the Liangzhe circuits, directed the defence of the Hunan line. Tanchow itself was held by the Hunan pacification commission and the prefect of the prefecture; Zhang Shijie moved river flotillas up and down to support the garrison, and Wen Tianxiang raised troops in Jiangxi to rally to the cause. The two sides were unequal in every respect. The Yuan army had Mongol cavalry as its backbone, supported by Chinese infantry, engineers and river troops, and its siege train included counterweight trebuchets and sappers. The Song fought on foot behind walls, answering with bows, crossbows, fire arrows and gunpowder devices. In arms, in supply and in firepower they belonged to different generations.
people: 元方主導者是伯顏。他以樞密院副使之銜統軍，取襄樊之後承擔東路主攻，決策重點在速下江南，故不等湖南全線肅清即分兵趨向潭州。阿術受命統兵入湖南，是潭州城下實際的指揮者之一；董文炳領江上水軍，范文虎以宋降將之身領沿海舟師，兩人保障糧秣與攻城器械的西上水道；呂文煥熟悉襄樊攻城舊事，充當工程與招撫之顧問；劉整自1268年降元後獻策取宋，元廷據此定下三路並進之全局。世祖忽必烈在北方以詔書調度前方，自至元十一年起屢詔添兵增糧。宋方主事者賈似道身任丞相且總領諸路兵馬，坐鎮鄂州、安慶一線，既懼元軍逼近，又恐部將權重，屢遣使議和，令前線處置反覆。潭州守將各書所記不一，常見者作李庭之，城陷之際率殘兵死守，而兵心已散。文天祥於江西募兵勤王，張世傑以舟師屢援江淮，皆未能挽回湖南戰局。
peopleEn: The principal figure on the Yuan side was Bayan. He commanded the army as deputy of the Privy Council and, after the fall of Xiangyang, took responsibility for the main thrust down the east, with his emphasis on speed in the reduction of the south, so that he detached troops towards Tanchow without waiting for every line in Hunan to be cleared. Asu was ordered to lead the troops into Hunan and was one of the actual commanders below the walls of Tanchow. Dong Wenbing commanded the river fleet on the Yangtze and Fan Wenhu, a former Song general who had gone over to the Yuan, led the coastal flotillas; between them they kept the water route open for grain and siege equipment coming up from the west. Lü Wenhuan, who knew the old siege works of Xiangyang intimately, served as adviser on engineering and on inducing surrenders. Liu Zheng, who had defected in 1268, gave the Yuan the plan for taking the Song, and the court built its three-pronged advance on his advice. Kublai Khan, far to the north, directed operations by edict and repeatedly ordered reinforcements and extra grain southward from the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan era. On the Song side the man in charge was Jia Sidao, chancellor and overall commander of all field armies, stationed along the Ezhou-Anqing line. Frightened by the advancing Yuan and equally afraid of over-mighty generals, he sent envoys to negotiate again and again, and the handling of the front collapsed into contradiction. The name of the garrison commander of Tanchow varies in the sources, but he is commonly given as Li Tingzhi, who held the city tower with what troops were left while the army's heart had already gone. Wen Tianxiang recruited troops in Jiangxi to rally to the dynasty, and Zhang Shijie brought the river fleet north to the rescue more than once; neither could turn the battle in Hunan.
kits: 卡面所配希臘火，嚴格說並未出現在潭州城頭。它是七世紀定型於拜占庭帝國的銅管噴射燃燒劑：以油膏為主料，點燃後噴出，遇水不易熄滅，可用於艦船近戰，因此被列為帝國最高機密，而配方隨一艘載有秘方的船沉海，技術自此難以複製。到十三世紀中葉，此類武器在歐洲留下的最後一批大規模海上使用記錄，是1267至1268年威尼斯與熱那亞爭奪拜占庭領土之戰。同一個年代，蒙古帝國已在西征之後直接經營地中海東岸與黑海貿易，1275年馬可波羅隨元使抵達上都，技術與情報的通道一直存在，只是沒有人把銅管火舟開進湘江。真正出現在潭州圍城序列中的，是同一條縱火技術譜系的華夏與回回版本：宋軍用猛火油，即天然石油製成的縱火劑，另有火矢與霹靂炮一類火藥器械；元軍用回回炮，即配重投石機，以及投擲用的火球與毒火陶罐，另有撞竿、雲梯與穴地用的器械。攻城器械與糧秣多由湘江舟船西上轉運，攻城者靠河泊營，宋守軍則靠城內存糧與沅江、洞庭方向的援糧維持。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card never actually stood on the walls of Tanchow. It was a burning mixture projected through a copper siphon, a weapon that took fixed form in the Byzantine empire in the seventh century: its base was an oily compound that once lit kept burning and was hard to extinguish with water, it was used in close action between ships, and it was therefore classed as the empire's highest military secret. The formula was carried on a single vessel that sank, and from that loss the technique could no longer be reproduced. By the middle of the thirteenth century the last large-scale records of this sort of weapon at sea in European sources belong to the war of 1267 and 1268 between Venice and Genoa for the remaining Byzantine lands. In the same decades, after the western expeditions, the Mongol empire was trading directly with the eastern Mediterranean and the Black Sea, and in 1275 Marco Polo reached the summer capital of the Yuan with a Yuan mission, so the channel for technique and for intelligence existed all along; no one, however, brought a copper-siphon fire ship up the Hsiang. What stood in the siege line at Tanchow were the Chinese and Muslim versions of the same burning-fluid family: the Song used menghuoyou, a naptha-based incendiary, together with fire arrows and gunpowder devices such as the thunder crash bomb; the Yuan used the huihui pao, the counterweight trebuchet, together with thrown fire balls and pots of toxic fire, and besides these the battering ram, the siege ladder and the tools for mining under the walls. The siege equipment and the grain came up the Hsiang by boat, the besiegers camped on the river, and the defenders were kept alive by stores inside the walls and by relief grain coming from the Yüan and Tung-t'ing directions.
tactics: 元軍的作法是分進合擊，斷水而後攻城。伯顏主力沿長江東下時刻意不放棄湖南，另派阿術等軍自江西道插入湘中，先以騎兵游騎封鎖潭州周邊道路，再在城外湘江沿岸泊舟紮營，把宋軍從江西、廣西兩方向來的援兵擋在水路之外。圍城之後，營盤環列城垣四面，砲位分置城角與突出部，砲彈所及以城頭樓櫓為主，輔以撞竿抵近城門與穴地掘進的反向攻城；攻擊分成晝夜兩班，日間以砲火消耗守軍，夜間收縮回營，令宋軍反擊難以放手。縱火手段用在兩處：一是焚燒宋軍出城反攻所賴的舟船與浮橋，二是把火球、毒火罐直接投入城頭缺口，切斷守軍補給與撤換的節奏。宋軍的守法是以城樓為骨幹，弓弩壓制城外逼近的攻隊，火器在城垛後施放，遇砲擊即退入甬道，夜晚再出城燒營反制。兩軍在湘江水道上同時爭奪制水權，元舟師以集群封鎖江面，宋舟師則以小舟穿插救護，糧道爭奪比攻城本身更決定久長。技術上，希臘火那一類銅管噴射裝置在此完全缺席，出面的是猛火油、火藥罐與配重投石機的組合。
tacticsEn: The Yuan method was to advance on several axes and converge, cutting the water before they took the city. While Bayan's main body ran down the Yangtze, he deliberately did not abandon Hunan, and Asu was sent in from the Jiangxi road into central Hunan. Light cavalry first sealed the roads around Tanchow, then the army moored along the Hsiang outside the walls and camped on the river, so that relief troops coming from Jiangxi and Kuangsi were held off on the water. Once the siege closed, the camp ringed the circuit of the walls, the trebuchets were posted at the corners and at salient points, and the stone was aimed at the towers and fighting platforms on the wall head, supported by battering rams brought up against the gates and by mining run in the opposite direction beneath the foundations. Attacks were run in two watches: gunpowder and stone by day to wear down the garrison, the camp pulled back at night so that the Song could not open a counterattack. Fire was used in two places: to burn the boats and floating bridges on which the Song sorties depended, and to throw fire balls and pots of toxic fire straight onto the breaches, cutting the rhythm by which the defenders were relieved and rotated. The Song defended with the tower platform as the skeleton, bows and crossbows pressing back the assault columns that closed on the walls, gunpowder weapons fired from behind the parapets, withdrawing into the covered ways when the stone came and coming out at night to burn the camp. On the Hsiang the two sides fought for the water at the same time, the Yuan flotillas closing the river in clusters while Song boats threaded through to rescue and supply. The contest over the grain route decided the length of the siege more than the assault itself. As for technique, the copper-siphon apparatus of the Greek fire was wholly absent here; what fought in the ditch was the combination of naptha, gunpowder pots and the counterweight trebuchet.
data: 可查證的數字有限，但有幾項時間與規模大致可靠。圍城起於至元十二年十一月，即1275年冬，至元十三年正月，1276年，潭州城破，圍攻歷時約二至三個月。潭州陷落至臨安出降，其間約一個月上下，1276年二月，宋廷奉上降表與傳國璽，說明元軍在潭州得手之後是沿湘江、洞庭湖、長江直下，節奏極快。元軍總兵力的說法各書不一，常見的「十餘萬」之數包含漠北騎兵、漢地步卒、舟師與襄樊降軍，不能視為同時投入一線的純戰鬥兵力。前期襄樊之戰自1267年圍城至1273年城陷，前後六年，回回炮在此役中造成重大破壞，其砲匠與攻城法隨軍東下，構成本戰攻城序列的技術前提。希臘火的使用歷程也有可對照的年表：七世紀定型，九世紀配方隨船沉海，十三世紀中葉僅存於地中海的海上戰鬥記錄，1267至1268年的威尼斯與熱那亞之戰是最後一批大用例。宋軍的霹靂炮與火矢在十三世紀文獻中已有記載，元軍的毒火陶罐同樣見於當時的戰記，兩類火器的投擲距離與殺傷半徑各書均無確數記載，不宜臆測。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but a few dates and sizes can be stated with fair confidence. The siege opened in the eleventh month of the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era, that is the winter of 1275, and the city fell in the first month of the following year, 1276, so the investment lasted roughly two to three months. Between the fall of Tanchow and the surrender of Lin'an there was only about a month: in the second month of 1276 the Song court delivered its petition of surrender and the imperial seal, which shows that the Yuan army, once it had Tanchow, went straight down the Hsiang, through the Tung-t'ing lake and into the Yangtze at a very great pace. The total strength of the Yuan army is given differently in different histories, and the commonly quoted figure of more than a hundred thousand men includes Mongol cavalry, Chinese infantry, river troops and the surrendered men of Xiangyang, so it cannot be read as a single body of pure combat troops committed to this one front. The earlier siege of Xiangyang, which began in 1267 and ended with the city's fall in 1273, lasted six years in all; the counterweight trebuchet did enormous damage there, and its artillery crews and siege methods travelled east and south with the army, and they are the technical precondition of the siege line at Tanchow. Greek fire has a comparable chronology: fixed in form in the seventh century, its formula lost with the ship in the ninth, and by the middle of the thirteenth century surviving only in Mediterranean records of fighting at sea, with the war between Venice and Genoa in 1267 and 1268 the last large applications. The Song thunder crash bomb and fire arrows are already recorded in thirteenth-century documents, and the Yuan pots of toxic fire appear in the war chronicles of the same age; for the throwing range and the destructive radius of both, no reliable figures survive in the sources, and none should be invented.
cause: 起戰有遠近兩層緣由。遠層是元朝要平定江南：至元十一年，伯顏取襄樊、樊城，荊襄屏障崩解，宋廷倚為長城的兩淮荊湖防線被打開缺口；元廷又以劉整所獻之策為骨幹，定下順流而下、直取臨安的戰略全盤。近層是潭州自身的樞紐地位與宋廷的應對失序。潭州是湖南路治所，坐落湘江要衝，向南控廣西、江西兩道，向北可窺洞庭與荊襄；只要湘江航路仍在宋軍手中，元軍在兩廣與江西的糧源和援兵就能北上，反之元軍在江南的戰略便沒有縱深，故必取潭州。1275年秋，元軍入湘的消息傳到臨安，朝廷命賈似道總領諸路兵馬，集兩淮、荊湖、兩浙之兵入湖南，但調兵文書往返、世家大將彼此掣肘，援軍多滯留半途，潭州城內守軍雖眾而無統一指揮，前線與朝廷之間的軍情屢被隱匿。乞和使節往來於江上，和議未成而元軍已兵臨城下，遂演成潭州之戰。
causeEn: The war has a distant and a proximate cause. The distant one is the Yuan determination to settle the south: in the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan era Bayan took Xiangyang and Fancheng, the Jingxiang barrier collapsed, and the two Huai and Jinghu lines that the Song had treated as its Great Wall were left with a gap in them. The Yuan built its whole strategic scheme on the plan offered by Liu Zheng, to come down the river and strike straight at Lin'an. The proximate cause lies in the position of Tanchow itself and in the disorder of the Song's response. Tanchow was the seat of the Hunan circuit, standing on the Hsiang artery, commanding Kuangsi and Jiangxi to the south and looking north to the Tung-t'ing lake and the Jingxiang. As long as the Hsiang navigation stayed in Song hands, the Yuan could not draw grain and troops from Kuangsi and Jiangxi up the river; without that the Yuan advance in the south had no depth, and so Tanchow had to be taken. When word of the Yuan entry into Hunan reached Lin'an in the autumn of 1275, the court ordered Jia Sidao to take overall command and to draw the armies of the Two Huai, the Jinghu and the Liangzhe circuits into Hunan. But the paperwork of mustering moved slowly, the great houses and their generals obstructed one another, relief armies stood half way, and inside Tanchow the garrison was numerous yet without a single command, while the reports from the front to the court were repeatedly suppressed. Envoys carrying proposals for peace passed to and fro on the river; the terms were not settled when the Yuan army was already at the walls, and the campaign became the battle of Tanchow.
impact: 潭州一失，江南的門戶洞開。元軍自潭州順湘江北入洞庭、再入長江，兵鋒數日之內抵達江浙，1276年二月臨安出降，宋廷奉上傳國璽，南宋中央統治至此崩解；其後三年宋室殘部退守海上，1279年崖山一役覆亡，江南入元。元代在湖南設行中書省，湘江與洞庭的航運被納入新的漕運與糧運體系，潭州由兩宋時期的湖南軍政中心轉為元代水陸轉輸的節點。技術層面的後果更長：這一戰線上火藥罐、火矢、投擲火球與回回砲同時大量使用，攻城不再只靠撞竿與雲梯，蒙古軍的攻城能力在兩湖與江南一線明顯躍升，中原火器技藝也隨軍隊與工匠向南方擴散。希臘火一類銅管噴射燃燒劑則走向另一條路：它隨拜占庭帝國的崩解而失傳，配方沉海的說法代代相傳，留下的只是一個技術已死的名字，與它在宋元戰場上的實物缺席恰好互為註腳。
impactEn: With Tanchow lost, the door into the south stood open. The Yuan army went up the Hsiang into the Tung-t'ing lake and into the Yangtze, and within days its spearhead stood in the Chiang-che and Che-hsiang; in the second month of 1276 Lin'an surrendered, the Song court handed over the imperial seal, and the central government of the Southern Song was finished. The remnants of the dynasty held on at sea for three more years and were destroyed at Yashan in 1279, and the south passed to the Yuan. The Yuan set up a provincial administration in Hunan, and the navigation of the Hsiang and the Tung-t'ing was folded into the new system of grain transport, so that Tanchow changed from a military centre of the two Song into a node of water and land transfer for the Yuan. The consequences in technique run longer still. Fire pots, fire arrows, thrown fire balls and the counterweight trebuchet were all used in quantity on this front; siege no longer rested on the battering ram and the ladder alone; the siege capability of the Mongol armies rose visibly in the Two Lakes and in the south of the Yangtze, and the craft of gunpowder weapons in the central plain spread southward together with the troops and the craftsmen. Greek fire and the copper-siphon burning mixtures followed a different road: they died with the collapse of the Byzantine empire, the story of the formula sinking with the ship passed from generation to generation, and what was left was only the name of a technique that was already dead, which is precisely the counterpart of its physical absence on the Song and Yuan battlefields.
result: 至元十三年正月，1276年，潭州城破。宋守軍在砲火與火攻之下失去抵抗能力，守將李庭之死守城樓直至城陷，部眾或降或散，元軍入城，控制了湘江中游的樞紐。此後元軍主力順水東進，江面舟師先行開路，約一個月後兵臨臨安，1276年二月，宋廷出降。潭州之勝的意義有三：一在戰略，打開了從兩湖到兩浙的連續水路，元軍由陸路攻堅轉為水陸並進、以水運養戰的形態；二在後勤，湘江成了元軍運糧運砲的通道，江南防線再無縱深；三在技術，砲火、毒火與火藥器械在城頭的密度，顯示十三世紀中葉攻城戰已進入以投射火力決定城頭歸屬的階段，與同時期地中海燃燒武器的使用遙相呼應，而真正的銅管噴射燃燒技術已在歐洲失傳，兩條技術線在這一場戰役裡擦肩而過。
resultEn: In the first month of the thirteenth year of the Zhiyuan era, in 1276, the walls of Tanchow were breached. The Song garrison, under stone and fire, lost the ability to resist; the commander Li Tingzhi held the tower until the city fell, his men surrendering or scattering; and the Yuan entered the city and took control of the hinge of the middle Hsiang. The main Yuan army then went east with the current, the river fleet leading the way, and about a month later stood before Lin'an, which surrendered in the second month of 1276. The victory at Tanchow meant three things. Strategically it opened an unbroken water road from the Two Lakes to the Two Che, and the Yuan army changed from a force that attacked overland into one that advanced by land and water together and provisioned itself by water. In logistics it turned the Hsiang into the artery for the Yuan grain and artillery, and the southern defence line of the Song was left with no depth at all. In technique it showed that the density of stone, toxic fire and gunpowder devices on the wall head had carried siege warfare into a stage in which the deciding factor was the volume of projected fire; this answered, across a distance, the use of burning weapons in the Mediterranean of the same period, while the true copper-siphon burning technique was already lost in Europe, and the two lines of technology passed one another without meeting in this battle.
